title: Grusch's terms came from crash retrieval program briefings

tellings.quote: yeah I think he's heard that from his briefings given to from the briefings given to him on the crash retrieval program

plain: The terms that David Grusch, a former intelligence officer turned UFO whistleblower, uses are said to come from briefings he was given on a crash retrieval program, a claimed secret effort to recover crashed craft of non-human origin. The physicist Eric W. Davis says this, giving it as his own view of where Grusch heard the words. If so, it would mean Grusch was briefed directly on such a program.
